subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should Telegram forum close, reopen, and delete be separate message actions with independent configuration gates?
rationale: Current create/edit support and the closed prior proposals do not establish approved public names, default enablement, or safety gates for destructive lifecycle operations.

options.title: Separate gated actions
options.body: Add `topic-close`, `topic-reopen`, and `topic-delete` with explicit Telegram-owned gates, documentation, tests, and live proof.

options.title: Overload edit and delete
options.body: Infer topic lifecycle behavior from topic identifiers on existing actions, reducing action count but introducing dual semantics and compatibility risk.

options.title: Defer destructive lifecycle
options.body: Keep create/edit only until maintainers explicitly sponsor broader agent-controlled topic administration.

recommendation.title: Separate gated actions
recommendation.body: Add `topic-close`, `topic-reopen`, and `topic-delete` with explicit Telegram-owned gates, documentation, tests, and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent current `topic-edit` capability and have the strongest direct feature-history signal.
